title: Sample Book A: Healthy Habits (dummy text)

pages.text: Regular sleep helps the body recover. Adults usually need seven to nine hours each night, and a fixed bedtime makes falling asleep easier.
Drinking water throughout the day supports concentration. Sugary drinks add calories without making you feel full.
Short walks after meals can help keep energy steady. Even ten minutes of movement is better than sitting all afternoon.

title: Sample Book B: Starting a Small Business (dummy text)

pages.text: A small business should track every invoice and expense from day one. Simple spreadsheets are enough at the start.
Customers return when replies are fast and polite. Answer questions within a day and keep a list of common questions.
Pricing should cover costs, time and a profit margin. Many new owners charge too little because they forget unpaid hours.

title: Sample Book C: Learning Python (dummy text)

pages.text: A function groups steps you want to reuse. Give it a clear name and keep it small so it is easy to test.
Lists store ordered items and dictionaries store values by key. Choose the structure that matches how you look data up.
Tests prove that code still works after a change. Write a test for the bug before fixing it so it cannot return.
